description: Create or update any file under the mapped plans root on the platform by relative path (no git commit/push required). Primary use: upload workflow execution plans at knowledge/workflow_plans/<workflow-id>/<workflow_execution_id>.plan.md after the Plan phase. filePath is relative to the plans mapped root (leading plans/ is stripped). Under workflow_plans/, filenames are coerced to *.plan.md and stored as WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_PLAN. Response includes supportFileId, filePath (canonical), filetype, created. Blocking step before Execute for cloud agents.
name: upsert-plans-support-file
